response: Saved Views is available today, included in all paid plans. It lets you save your favorite filters, sorting, and grouping so you can jump back into the exact view of your work without rebuilding it each time. Whether you track tasks by priority, assignee, or due date, capture that setup once and return to it instantly. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving plenty of room to organize views for different projects, clients, or workflows. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating filters on their own. This makes standups, sprint reviews, and status reports faster to prepare, since the right view is always one click away. No extra setup is required beyond your existing workspace, and it works across every list and board in your account. Give it a try on your busiest project today. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
